alan_support: Customer reported HTTP 413 from /v1/rerank when sending a long query + ~120 docs. Customer says the error message just says 'Payload too large' and they can't tell which part to trim.

sophie_eng: Can you paste the request they used (redact PII)?

alan_support: Yep, repro curl below (redacted):

alan_support: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"query":"'""very long customer query... ~3.2k chars"'"", "docs":[{"id":"1","text":"long doc text... ~5k chars"}, {"id":"2","text":"..."}, /* ~120 items */]}'
```

alan_support: Server responded 413 with body: `{\"error\":\"Payload too large\"}` — no token count or hint. Customer is confused about whether to shorten the query, split docs, or reduce doc count.

sophie_eng: Thanks. Likely hit our combined token/char ceiling for the rerank route. Two quick asks: (1) capture the exact token/byte counts from the logs, (2) decide UX wording we want to return so customers know remediation steps. I'll grab logs. @infra_bot can you paste the request id trace?

infra_bot: Alert: trace_id=trc-8f3b2c, route=/v1/rerank, client=acct-998, status=413, bytes_in=512089, token_est=24120, docs_count=120, query_chars=3204

josh_dev: token_est=24120 — that matches hitting the backend token ceiling (24k). Current rerank limit is effectively ~20k tokens after overhead; docs count also matters for compute limits.

alan_support: Customer asked: can we return error like '413: combined token limit exceeded (query 3.2k chars, docs total ~512KB, ~24k tokens). Reduce docs or truncate documents. See https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits'? They want explicit guidance.

josh_dev: Agreed we should do better than generic 'Payload too large'. Proposal for error payload: `{\"error\":\"combined_token_limit_exceeded\", \"limit_tokens\":\"20000\", \"estimated_tokens\":\"24120\", \"docs_count\":\"120\", \"hint\":\"Trim query, batch documents (<=25 per request) or shorten docs. See /docs/rerank#limits\"}`

alan_support: That would be great. Also customer worried about billing: if a request fails with 413, are they charged for anything?

josh_dev: No charge on rejection paths. We should add that to the error hint text and to billing KB. Quick patch: add hint line 'No usage billed for requests rejected due to limits.'

sophie_eng: Two follow-ups: (A) Define a recommended chunking pattern for our KB (e.g., split docs >2k tokens, batch size 20-30), (B) decide whether to auto-truncate long queries (dangerous for rerank quality). My vote: do not auto-truncate queries, but we can provide a best-effort server-side snippet that suggests truncation boundaries.

alan_support: I'll reply to the customer with repro steps to split docs into batches of 25 and retry; include the new suggested error wording and the billing note. Will escalate to product for the API change. :thumbsup:

josh_dev: Adding a low-risk server change: detailed 4xx machine-readable error + human hint. We'll file ENG-PRIORITY ticket and add to release notes.

infra_bot: Ticket created: RED-8421 - return structured limit errors for /v1/rerank (owner=josh_dev, priority=high)

alan_support: Thanks team — will update customer and paste their follow-up here.

alan_support: (later) Customer tried batching 25 docs per request and it worked. They asked if we have an SDK helper to automatically chunk + retry.

josh_dev: We don't currently, but it's a great SDK utility. I'll add a note to RED-8421 to include a code snippet for chunking in SDKs.

sophie_eng: Nice. Closing here once PR lands and KB updated.
